Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

futebolplotR 0.1.0

Breaking changes

  • futebolplotR now requires ggplot2 >= 4.0.0 and ggpath >= 1.1.0. (#4)
  • futebolplotR now requires R >= 4.1.
  • element_futebol_badge() is now an S7 class, built on ggpath::element_path(), to work with the new S7 theme system of ggplot2 4. (#4)

New features

  • Added Mirassol (MIR) badge and colors. (#1)
  • Maringá (MGA) is now part of the exported teams_colors_badges dataset.
  • Documented the datasets futebol_team_abbr_mapping and teams_colors_badges.
  • Added an annotate() example to the Getting Started article. (#3)

Bug fixes and minor improvements

  • geom_futebol_badges() and element_futebol_badge() are much faster. Each badge is now rasterised only once per session and reused, and alpha no longer goes through magick::image_fx(). A scatter plot of 20 badges with alpha went from ~25 s to ~1.7 s (first draw) and ~0.1 s (redraws).
  • element_futebol_badge() works again. It supports colour (including "b/w"), alpha, angle and size, and works in axis text and facet strips. (#4)
  • geom_futebol_badges() and element_futebol_badge() warn about unknown team abbreviations and draw a generic badge instead of leaving an empty space.
  • Team data now lives in data-raw/teams.csv, so the package doesn’t depend on brasileirao anymore (it’s only used in the Getting Started article).
  • Team names are now stored in UTF-8.
  • Badge files moved to inst/badges/.
  • Removed unused dependencies glue and lifecycle; brasileirao and withr moved to Suggests.
  • Added unit and visual tests.

futebolplotR 0.0.2

  • Add Maringa Futebol Clube (MGA) badge

futebolplotR 0.0.1

  • Initial submission.
